    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenClaw 快速入门：10 分钟完成本地安装与配置（附常用命令速查）</span>

		<div class="clear"></div>

<h1 id="openclaw-部署与使用指南">OpenClaw 部署与使用指南</h1>
<p>OpenClaw 是一个开源的个人 AI 助手项目，2026 年 1 月在 GitHub 上火了起来。和其他只能聊天的 AI 不同，OpenClaw 可以直接操作你的系统——读写文件、执行命令、跑代码、操作浏览器、处理邮件等等。</p>
<p>简单说，它不是和你对话的工具，而是帮你干活的工具。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/fe0e8572-f35b-4e20-8b00-7723e48ec498.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="关于项目名称">关于项目名称</h2>
<p>你可能看到过三个名字：Clawdbot、Moltbot、OpenClaw。这是一个项目：</p>
<ul>
<li>最早叫 Clawdbot</li>
<li>1 月底因为商标问题改名为 Moltbot</li>
<li>最后定名为 OpenClaw</li>
</ul>
<p>功能完全一样，命令也兼容。</p>
<ul>
<li>官网：<a href="https://openclaw.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://openclaw.ai/</a></li>
<li>GitHub：<a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="本地安装">本地安装</h2>
<h3 id="一键安装">一键安装</h3>
<p>最简单的方式，直接运行安装脚本：</p>
<p><strong>macOS/Linux:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Windows PowerShell:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-powershell">iwr -useb https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1 | iex
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Windows CMD:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-cmd">curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd &amp;&amp; install.cmd &amp;&amp; del install.cmd
</code></pre>
<h3 id="手动安装">手动安装</h3>
<p>如果已经装了 Node.js ≥22：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">npm i -g openclaw
# 或
pnpm add -g openclaw
</code></pre>
<p>然后运行初始化：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw onboard
</code></pre>
<h3 id="从源码安装">从源码安装</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw
pnpm install
pnpm ui:build
pnpm build
pnpm openclaw onboard --install-daemon
pnpm gateway:watch
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="初始化配置">初始化配置</h2>
<p>安装完成后会进入配置向导，几个关键选项说明一下：</p>
<p><strong>风险确认</strong>：OpenClaw 需要系统权限来完成任务，选 Yes 继续。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/e1de4820-039c-42f8-9189-761ca9baa593.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>安装模式</strong>：新手选 QuickStart 即可。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/78ba08f8-9c17-476d-9c01-fecf9741bc57.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>AI 模型</strong>：</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/9a5a1c3e-2826-4349-8e80-2fa228b903f2.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>国内用户可以用 Qwen、MiniMax、智谱。有海外账号的推荐 Claude 或 GPT-4。暂时不确定可以先跳过，后面通过配置文件改。</p>
<p><strong>聊天通道</strong>：</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/434ba7fb-a0c4-4168-9b9f-a89ed80021e2.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>海外用户选 WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord，国内用户可以跳过，后面配置飞书。</p>
<p><strong>端口</strong>：默认 18789，不用改。</p>
<p>配置完成后浏览器会自动打开 <a href="http://127.0.0.1:18789/chat" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://127.0.0.1:18789/chat</a></p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Moltbot-Clawdbot-runoob3.webp" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="云服务器部署">云服务器部署</h2>
<p>阿里云和腾讯云都有现成的镜像，可以直接用。</p>
<h3 id="阿里云">阿里云</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.aliyun.com/activity/ecs/clawdbot" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.aliyun.com/activity/ecs/clawdbot</a></p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://www.runoob.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/c6da4d06-b50f-4b11-aebc-bdea5c5db859-scaled.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="腾讯云">腾讯云</h3>
<p><a href="https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2624973" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2624973</a></p>
<p><strong>步骤：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>用 OpenClaw 镜像重装系统（注意不是 Moltbot）</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="386c6ae2-ea4c-4744-a458-23dede64b906" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606415-1681430355.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>登录服务器终端，运行 <code>openclaw onboard</code></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="image-20260130092528011" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605313-420511351.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>后续配置和本地安装一样。如果要用国内模型，建议先跳过模型配置，后面手动改配置文件。</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131080336392" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605522-1525839888.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="公网访问配置">公网访问配置</h2>
<p>云服务器部署后如果需要从外网访问，需要额外配置。</p>
<h3 id="websocket-配置">WebSocket 配置</h3>
<p>接入 Telegram/WhatsApp 等需要：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw configure
</code></pre>
<p>把 Gateway 地址改成公网 IP：</p>
<p><img alt="3248ac61-7cdc-4ebd-af79-f9176d3d0b6d" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605567-1817231238.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>认证方式选 Token。</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131082124288" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605679-1338621944.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="web-ui-远程访问">Web UI 远程访问</h3>
<p>编辑 <code>~/.openclaw/openclaw.json</code>，把 <code>mode</code> 改成 <code>remote</code>，<code>bind</code> 改成 <code>lan</code>，然后重启服务。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw gateway stop
openclaw gateway start
</code></pre>
<p>查看 token：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="630df128-917e-4751-8ad6-5fa47f16c2a7" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606097-370450759.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>访问 URL 加上 <code>&amp;token=xxx</code></p>
<p><img alt="22d60d46-bade-4bc3-9332-5942cde504d2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606169-1876818599.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="设备授权">设备授权</h3>
<p>如果出现 <code>pairing required</code> 错误：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw devices list
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="3f8d2aad-3c14-4822-aa49-b848c4c53aff" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605551-1523680332.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>复制 Pending 里的 Request ID 授权：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw devices approve b8eb70dd...
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="6dd4cca8-38d7-45f9-93e1-f4758f4b40c2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605801-733793042.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="国内模型配置">国内模型配置</h2>
<h3 id="moonshot-kimi">Moonshot (Kimi)</h3>
<ol>
<li>创建 API Key：<a href="https://platform.moonshot.cn/console/api-keys" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://platform.moonshot.cn/console/api-keys</a></li>
<li>查看可用模型：<a href="https://platform.moonshot.cn/playground" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://platform.moonshot.cn/playground</a></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="ef99563e-fffd-4c8f-bbe4-c90c864fc0da" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605934-2039061759.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="kimi-code">Kimi Code</h3>
<ol>
<li>购买编程模型：<a href="https://www.kimi.com/code" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.kimi.com/code</a></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="image-20260131100451955" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606354-801022956.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>创建 API Key：<a href="https://www.kimi.com/code/console?from=kfc_overview_topbar" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.kimi.com/code/console?from=kfc_overview_topbar</a></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="b030bb77-45eb-43e2-b8dc-81742667f569" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605905-1154285968.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="修改配置文件">修改配置文件</h3>
<p>编辑 <code>~/.openclaw/openclaw.json</code>，把下面的内容加进去（替换 API Key）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "moonshot/kimi-k2.5"
      },
      "maxConcurrent": 4,
      "subagents": {
        "maxConcurrent": 8
      },
      "workspace": "/root/.openclaw/workspace"
    }
  },
  "models": {
    "mode": "merge",
    "providers": {
      "moonshot": {
        "baseUrl": "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1",
        "apiKey": "${MOONSHOT_API_KEY}",
        "api": "openai-completions",
        "models": [
          {
            "id": "kimi-k2.5",
            "name": "Kimi K2.5"
          }
        ]
      },
      "kimi-code": {
        "baseUrl": "https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1",
        "apiKey": "${KIMICODE_API_KEY}",
        "api": "openai-completions",
        "models": [
          {
            "id": "kimi-for-coding",
            "name": "Kimi For Coding"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>重启服务生效：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw gateway restart
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="飞书集成">飞书集成</h2>
<h3 id="1-创建飞书应用">1. 创建飞书应用</h3>
<p>打开 <a href="https://open.feishu.cn/app%EF%BC%8C%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E6%B7%BB%E5%8A%A0%E6%9C%BA%E5%99%A8%E4%BA%BA%E8%83%BD%E5%8A%9B%E3%80%82" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://open.feishu.cn/app，创建应用，添加机器人能力。</a></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131144706538" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606867-1235744726.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="2-配置权限">2. 配置权限</h3>
<p>开通消息和群组相关权限。</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131144812115" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606565-707707860.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="3-配置事件">3. 配置事件</h3>
<p>使用长连接，添加消息接收事件。</p>
<p><img alt="625aff5d-48cd-4ee4-86a0-090d8d316eec" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164607010-1852271788.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131144858161" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605937-426452100.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="4-连接-openclaw">4. 连接 OpenClaw</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw configure
</code></pre>
<p>选择 Channels，填入飞书的 App ID 和 App Secret。</p>
<p><img alt="15490039-6f2a-42da-aedb-fcfa8415be54" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606150-528867752.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131113353214" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164606173-1504832911.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260131145004834" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202601/1315495-20260131164605317-1043045340.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="常用命令">常用命令</h2>
<h3 id="基础">基础</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw status          # 运行状态
openclaw health          # 健康检查
openclaw doctor          # 诊断问题
openclaw doctor --deep   # 深度检查
openclaw configure       # 修改配置
</code></pre>
<h3 id="gateway">Gateway</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw gateway start
openclaw gateway stop
openclaw gateway restart
openclaw gateway status
</code></pre>
<h3 id="通道">通道</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw channels list
openclaw channels login           # WhatsApp 扫码
openclaw channels add             # 添加 Telegram/Discord
openclaw channels status --probe
</code></pre>
<h3 id="模型">模型</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw models list
openclaw models status
openclaw models auth setup-token
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置">配置</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw config get &lt;path&gt;
openclaw config set &lt;path&gt; &lt;value&gt;
openclaw config unset &lt;path&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="日志">日志</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw logs
openclaw logs --follow
</code></pre>
<h3 id="记忆和技能">记忆和技能</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openclaw memory search "关键词"
openclaw memory index
openclaw skills list
clawhub install &lt;skill&gt;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="文件路径">文件路径</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">路径</th>
<th style="text-align: left">用途</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>~/.openclaw/openclaw.json</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">主配置文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>~/.openclaw/workspace/</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">工作区</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>~/.openclaw/credentials/</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">API 密钥</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>~/.openclaw/memory/</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">长期记忆存储</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>~/.openclaw/skills/</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">技能目录</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>/tmp/openclaw/*.log</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">日志文件</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>工作区文件：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code>AGENTS.md</code> - 给 AI 的指令</li>
<li><code>USER.md</code> - 用户偏好</li>
<li><code>MEMORY.md</code> - 长期记忆</li>
<li><code>HEARTBEAT.md</code> - 定期检查清单</li>
<li><code>SOUL.md</code> - 人格设定</li>
<li><code>BOOT.md</code> - 启动配置</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="聊天命令">聊天命令</h2>
<p>在聊天界面可以用：</p>
<pre><code>/status              查看状态
/context list        查看上下文
/model &lt;模型&gt;        切换模型
/compact             精简窗口
/new                 新对话
/stop                停止任务
/tts on/off          语音开关
/think               切换推理模式
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="常见问题">常见问题</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">问题</th>
<th style="text-align: left">解决</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">不回消息</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>openclaw status</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">私信没反应</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>openclaw devices list</code> 批准设备</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">群里不响应</td>
<td style="text-align: left">检查提及模式</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">认证过期</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>openclaw models auth setup-token</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">服务异常</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>openclaw doctor --deep</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">记忆问题</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>openclaw memory index</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
